Since the award ceremony occurs on 4 November—Jamnalal Bajaj’s birth anniversary—use this date as a trigger. When you hear or see “November 4,” immediately recall the award’s presentation date and the connection to Jamnalal Bajaj’s life and values. This creates a strong associative memory.
